sections.title: How to choose your tools
sections.lead: Match your tools to your stage. There is no need to pay for data you will not use.

cards.title: Just starting
cards.text: Use Search Console, GA4 and Google Business Profile. All three are free and cover most early needs.

cards.title: Site feels slow
cards.text: Run PageSpeed Insights on your top pages. Then fix the issues it lists first.

cards.title: Adding schema
cards.text: Test every FAQ or product page in the Rich Results Test before and after you publish.

cards.title: Cleaning up a big site
cards.text: Crawl it with Screaming Frog. The free version covers sites under 500 URLs.

cards.title: Chasing rivals
cards.text: Add Ahrefs or Semrush to see their links and keywords. One of the two is usually enough.

cards.title: Tracking AI answers
cards.text: Ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity the questions your buyers ask each month, and note who gets named. This is the core of AEO and GEO tracking.

sections.title: Set up the free tools in an hour
sections.lead: These four steps give you a working toolkit today.
steps: First, verify your site in Google Search Console and submit your sitemap.
Add Google Analytics 4 and mark form sends and calls as key events.
Then claim your Google Business Profile and fill in every field.
Finally, test your home page in PageSpeed Insights and the Rich Results Test.
